comment: Glass Dynamics glazing layups. Plies are listed from the front (struck) face. Panes are flat and simply supported in their frame; curved windscreens are treated as flat panes of the same area.

glazings.name: Annealed float, 6 mm
glazings.description: Plain window and shop-front glass. Breaks into long, sharp shards.

provenance.damping: published: monolithic glass panes in frames, 0.5-2 % modal damping
provenance.frame_grip_Nm: estimated: gasket and bead friction holding a loose shard by its edge

provenance.damping: published: monolithic glass panes in frames, 0.5-2 % modal damping

glazings.name: Heat-strengthened, 6 mm
glazings.description: Twice the strength of annealed glass; breaks into large pieces that tend to stay in the frame.

provenance.plies: published: ASTM C1048 heat-strengthened surface compression 24-52 MPa; 40 MPa taken

glazings.name: Fully tempered, 6 mm
glazings.description: Safety glass for doors and showers. Four to five times stronger; breaks into small dice.
glazings.standard: EN 12150-1 / ASTM C1048 (surface compression >= 69 MPa) / ANSI Z97.1

provenance.plies: published: fully tempered surface compression 69-150 MPa (ASTM C1048); typical production ~100 MPa

glazings.name: Car side window, tempered 4 mm
glazings.description: Door glass: tempered so it crumbles into blunt dice. A spring-loaded window punch breaks it.
glazings.standard: UN ECE R43 (40-400 fragments in any 50 x 50 mm square)

provenance.plies: estimated: automotive door glass is tempered harder than architectural, ~110-130 MPa surface compression
provenance.width_m: estimated: a typical front door drop glass, flattened

glazings.name: Car windscreen, laminated 2.1 / 0.76 PVB / 2.1
glazings.description: Two annealed plies bonded by PVB: cracks in a spider web but holds together and stops the occupant.
glazings.standard: UN ECE R43 / ANSI Z26.1 AS1 (2.26 kg ball from 4 m must not pass)

provenance.edge_hold_kNm: estimated: a polyurethane bead bonding the glass to the body, ~5 MPa over ~20 mm
provenance.plies: published: the common passenger-car windscreen layup
provenance.damping: estimated: PVB interlayer raises modal damping to several percent

glazings.name: Laminated safety glass 3 / 0.38 PVB / 3
glazings.description: Two thin annealed plies with a PVB interlayer: the shards stay stuck to the film.

provenance.plies: published: standard 6.38 mm laminated safety glass

glazings.name: Hurricane laminate 6 HS / 2.28 ionoplast / 6 HS
glazings.description: Stiff structural interlayer between heat-strengthened plies, for windborne debris.
glazings.standard: ASTM E1996 large missile D (4.1 kg 2x4 at 15.2 m/s)

glazings.name: Bullet-resistant laminate, 30 mm (UL 752 Level 1 class)
glazings.description: Five annealed plies and PVB. Stops 9 mm; the back ply may spall.
glazings.standard: UL 752 Level 1 (9 mm FMJ, 358-394 m/s, 3 shots)

provenance.plies: estimated: representative of 1.2 in all-glass Level 1 products; not a certified product
provenance.bite_mm: estimated: bullet-resistant glazing sits about 1 in (25 mm) deep in a steel frame, held by its sealant bond

glazings.name: Glass-clad polycarbonate, 32 mm (UL 752 Level 3 class)
glazings.description: Glass faces crush the bullet; a polycarbonate back catches it with no spall.

provenance.plies: estimated: representative glass-clad polycarbonate Level 3 build-up; not a certified product
provenance.bite_mm: estimated: bullet-resistant glazing sits about 1 in (25 mm) deep in a steel frame, held by its sealant bond

glazings.name: Rifle-rated glass-clad polycarbonate, 52 mm (UL 752 Level 8 class)
glazings.description: Five thick glass plies over polycarbonate, for 7.62 mm rifle fire.
glazings.standard: UL 752 Level 8 (7.62 mm NATO ball, 838-922 m/s, 5 shots)

provenance.plies: estimated: representative rifle-rated build-up; not a certified product
provenance.bite_mm: estimated: bullet-resistant glazing sits about 1 in (25 mm) deep in a steel frame, held by its sealant bond

glazings.name: Glass-clad polycarbonate, 95 mm (UL 752 Level 10 class)
glazings.description: Six thick glass plies over a polycarbonate backing, for a .50 calibre rifle: nearly twice the thickness of the Level 8 build.
glazings.standard: UL 752 Level 10 (.50 caliber 708 gr, 856-942 m/s, 1 shot)

provenance.plies: estimated: representative .50-calibre-rated build-up, sized so the model stops the Level 10 round; not a certified product
provenance.bite_mm: estimated: bullet-resistant glazing sits about 1 in (25 mm) deep in a steel frame, held by its sealant bond

glazings.name: Transport aircraft windshield (chemically strengthened, 3 plies)
glazings.description: A thin outer ply over two ion-exchanged structural plies with urethane between, pressurised from inside. Either structural ply alone carries the cabin pressure (fail-safe).
glazings.standard: 14 CFR 25.775 (1.8 kg bird at V_C without penetration)

provenance.edge_hold_kNm: estimated: bolted through the edge members of the windshield frame
provenance.plies: estimated: representative of published transport-category windshield construction (outer abrasion ply, heated urethane, two structural ion-exchanged plies); not a specific type
provenance.pressure_kPa: published: 8.6 psi maximum cabin differential of current transport jets (negative: pushes outward, toward the struck face)

glazings.name: Armoured car windscreen, 32 mm glass-clad polycarbonate
glazings.description: Four glass plies on polyurethane with a thin polycarbonate spall liner. Rated against handguns and submachine guns: each round crushes a white crater and a spider web, and the liner keeps the glass out of the cabin.
glazings.standard: EN 1063 BR4 / VPAM 4 class (9 mm and .44 Magnum, 3 shots)

provenance.edge_hold_kNm: estimated: polyurethane-bonded behind a steel overlap frame
provenance.plies: estimated: representative of 30-35 mm handgun-rated automotive glass-clad polycarbonate; not a certified product
provenance.width_m: estimated: a small grand tourer's windscreen, flattened
provenance.frame_grip_Nm: estimated: armoured glazing is bonded into a steel frame

glazings.name: Armoured supercar windscreen, 32 mm glass-clad polycarbonate
glazings.description: The armoured windscreen's layup in a mid-engined supercar's screen: bigger, and raked about 70 degrees, so rounds from the front strike it at a glancing angle, see a much thicker barrier and sometimes skip off.
glazings.standard: EN 1063 BR4 / VPAM 4 class (9 mm and .44 Magnum, 3 shots)

provenance.edge_hold_kNm: estimated: polyurethane-bonded behind a steel overlap frame
provenance.plies: estimated: as armoured_windscreen; not a certified product
provenance.width_m: estimated: the flat that best fits the Rosser V8 model's windscreen (rake 69.5 degrees)
provenance.frame_grip_Nm: estimated: armoured glazing is bonded into a steel frame

glazings.name: Storefront panel, fully tempered 10 mm
glazings.description: A floor-to-ceiling shop window: one big sheet of fully tempered glass.

provenance.plies: published: fully tempered surface compression 69-150 MPa (ASTM C1048); typical production ~100 MPa
provenance.width_m: estimated: a floor-to-ceiling storefront panel between mullions

glazings.name: Glass door, fully tempered 10 mm
glazings.description: A frameless shop door: fully tempered, as safety glazing in doors must be.

provenance.plies: published: fully tempered surface compression 69-150 MPa (ASTM C1048); typical production ~100 MPa
provenance.width_m: estimated: a frameless shop door leaf

glazings.name: Transom over a door, fully tempered 6 mm
glazings.description: The small fixed panel above a shop door.

provenance.plies: published: fully tempered surface compression 69-150 MPa (ASTM C1048); typical production ~100 MPa
provenance.width_m: estimated: the transom above a 2.1 m door

glazings.name: Armoured car side glass, 32 mm glass-clad polycarbonate
glazings.description: The armoured windscreen's layup in a door frame: fixed, it no longer winds down.
glazings.standard: EN 1063 BR4 / VPAM 4 class (9 mm and .44 Magnum, 3 shots)

provenance.edge_hold_kNm: estimated: polyurethane-bonded behind a steel overlap frame
provenance.plies: estimated: as armoured_windscreen; not a certified product
provenance.width_m: estimated: a two-door coupe's side glass, flattened
